name: Salvage Hunters
description: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: As owner of one of the largest decorative salvage yards in the United Kingdom - Fabulously British Salvage - Drew Pritchard is always looking for new pieces to replenish his shop, and he has no problem scouring the countryside to find them. This series follows Drew all over the country, including some privileged estates, as he hunts for old and forgotten pieces of history. But finding them is only part of the business; Drew must then convince the owner of each item to sell it to him at a fair price, then it's off to the salvage yard, where his team restores it to its original shine before it can be sold for profit.

videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the UK in search of weird and wonderful objects.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the UK in search of weird and wonderful objects.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Drew and Tee head to Cornwall to visit a brewery in St Austell. Plus, they stop in Penzance and go for a surf in the sea during the southwest adventure.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: In the Cotswolds, Drew Pritchard looks around an impressive manor house. He then visits a converted Chapel in Burnley filled with incredible antiques and a car showroom in Jersey.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard visit a shop in Lincolnshire filled with a plethora of valuable treasures. He also stops by at an impressive house in Yorkshire to see whether there is anything for sale.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee scour the British coastline for treasure. On their 280 mile trek from North Wales to the Essex Coast, they uncover a terrific triple sink and a bank of pine drawers.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee head to a salvage yard in Clacton-on-Sea, Essex and unearth a quirky enamel advertising sign. Drew also managers to nab the deal of the Century with a work of art in London.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard is thrilled to look through an oddball collection of military antiques in Nantes, France. Plus, he takes an interest in a de Sede sofa bed in the Netherlands.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: In Leeds Drew Pritchard and Tee visit two dealers who have been collecting since 1971. Drew uncovers an old industrial stool and some ceramic hand moulds.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee are excited by the items on offer at the largest antique market in Italy. They also view a fascinating collection in a picturesque town in Spain.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard scours sites around the UK for potentially valuable scrap items and forgotten remnants.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: In Gloucestershire, drew uncovers a marble top lamp and a painting of a mackerel. Later, he's thrilled to look around a stately home in Bedfordshire

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the UK in search of weird and wonderful objects. The bigger the hoard, the happier he is.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee view a collection in Boreham Wood, Hertfordshire. Everything is up for sale, including a carved stone saint and marble fireplace supports.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard Drew and Tee visit a 500-year-old copper mine in the village of Coniston, Cumbria. They uncover a slipware dairy bowl, pattern wheels and a retail counter.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard heads to rural Somerset to rummage through a salvage yard. He tries to buy an industrial ceiling light, a marble column plinth and an antiques sign.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: At a railway museum in Somerset, Drew Pritchard and Tee uncover two rare signs from the 1920s. Later, Drew finds shoe lasts made for music legend Paul McCartney.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Hunting items with a distinctly French connection, aspiring collector and TV star Fred Sirieix joins Drew Pritchard and Tee John on the road to learn the trade.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Drew and Tee visit a salvage yard that specialises in stoneware. Blown away by the quality and rarity of some of the items, Drew is forced to haggle hard by the canny dealer.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard visits a heritage railway in Minehead, Somerset, where he finds a fantastic selection of pieces. The highlight of the trip is a ride in the cab of a vintage steam train.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the UK in search of weird and wonderful objects.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee head to a family run antiques business in Yorkshire with a no-nonsense owner. He has to haggle hard, but Drew bags himself an elegant 19th century bachelor's chest.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee seek out the very best antiques the Isle of Wight has to offer. Their first stop is the seaside town of Ventnor, a fashionable holiday resort in Victorian times.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Tee visit a grade II listed mansion in Lincolnshire packed with items. Drew haggles for a superb 19th-century chair and a decorated chinoiserie mirror

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard stops at a salvage yard, which he hails as the best in the country. He and companion Tee find a pair of beautifully crafted sundials and an overthrow believed to be from Belvoir Castle

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Drew and Tee explore a restored castle in the Scottish Lowlands and then up to the Scottish capital of Edinburgh, once known as the Athens of the North, for a bit of antique shopping.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Drew and Tee plumb for treasures in County Durham.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Drew accepts a private invitation to one of the grandest stately homes in the country, Palace House. He is stunned by its large collection of electric light fittings and other amazing features.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: On a trip to Sheffield, Drew tries to agree a deal on some incredible industrial pieces. Later, he checks out a collection of unusual hunting artefacts in Ludlow.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Drew lets the money roll in Newcastle to replenish his stock of Victorian furniture. He then visits a neglected country house where he finds a treasure trove of hidden gems.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Drew manages to get his hands on an impressive collection of antiques at an 18th century manor. Plus, he checks out a garden filled that is home to more than 200 life-sized sculptures.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Comedian Johnny Vegas joins Drew on a special salvage road trip. They visit an amazing collection of outsider art in Wigan and a warehouse full of illuminations in Blackpool.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels to Spain.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels to Stratford and Sheffield.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Drew buys a 19th century lamp in the Scottish Borders. Later he visits a combined bar and antiques shop in the Ribble Valley.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Drew visits vintage furniture dealer Morbleu in Lambeth. Later he discovers a rare botanical art book in West Yorkshire.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Drew gets a exclusive invitation to the estate of a tech tycoon and visits a house clearance in Wolverhampton.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: In the south of England, Drew visits some collectors who specialise in natural objects. And he is not disappointed by their collections.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: In Suffolk, Drew goes on a spending spree when he finds antiques imported from France. Later, in Lancashire, he falls in love with a piece of bamboo furniture.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Drew picks up a collection of mid-century snout sticks in Suffolk originally used in pig auctions. Next, Drew and Tee spot gothic treasure in a Swansea film studio.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As the seventeenth series gets underway, Drew and Tee head to the former East Germany, birthplace of early modern design. They visit a fair full of Bauhaus brilliance in Berlin and one of Europe's largest flea markets.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Big changes are afoot for Drew in Conwy. He hunts for fresh stock in a stunning 1730s Sussex mansion, and in Lincoln he spots an unusual 19th century medical cabinet.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In Suffolk, Drew spots an architectural wreath that is over 100 years old.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In Fulham, Drew prepares to spend big with some elite dealers. In Hastings, Drew and Tee unearth some unusual Chinese watercolours and a Turkish rug.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Modern day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard travels the length and breadth of the UK in search of weird and wonderful objects. The bigger the hoard, the happier he is.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Drew is joined by his son Tom, who is keen to learn more about the trade. They head to Trinity Marine in Devon, where a Siebe Gorman diving helmet catches the eye.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Drew bids on an elaborate Victorian mirror and and a stash of Welsh blankets.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Drew and Tee travel to four extraordinary locations across Northern Italy, including the country's most famed antique markets and a dreamy Tuscan villa

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Drew and Tee go hunting for antiques in the homes of fellow dealers. Tucked away in the Cotswolds, Drew finds an ancient Greek masterpiece from 100 BC.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Drew encounters thrilling examples by three design titans who shaped the classic Georgian-and-Victorian look: Sir John Soane, Augustus Pugin and William Morris.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Drew visits a disused fuel shed on a former air force base in Suffolk, where he discovers vases carved from cow bones and a haunting stone face corbel.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Drew and Tee visit Newark, a town renowned for its antique connections. Drew finds a set of Regency bed steps and a genuine, very rare 18th century mirror

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Drew and Tee visit Insect Circus in Suffolk, they discover a giant pair of 20th Century stage shoes and scratch made models of fairground rides.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Drew visits a large antique emporium, the largest collection of automobilia in Britain and both the shop and warehouse of a well established dealer. His find include a painting collection, signs, furniture, lighting and a blown glass vase.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Drew finds a genuine marble bust from the 1860s in Surrey.

videos.title: Portugal Special
videos.overview: Drew and Tee take a trip to Portugal, a hidden gem of the antiques trade. They unearth some architectural marvels recovered from an 18th century church.

videos.title: Every Day is a School Day
videos.overview: Drew never knows what he might find, who he'll meet, or what he'll learn. He visits an outsider artist with a newly curated art collection.

videos.title: Different Visions
videos.overview: Drew meets dealers who see antiques in different ways. He finds a carved lion with a mysterious back-story, and four chairs by his design hero, Pugin.

videos.title: Shop Local
videos.overview: Drew seeks out antiques that are rich with local provenance. On the Scottish border, he finds a Georgian Cockpen chair, then snaps up a chilling art piece in North Wales.

videos.title: Masters of the Trade
videos.overview: On a trip from Manchester to Hampshire, Drew visits expert dealers, snapping up a campaign chair, a Georgian bookcase, and a 19th-century carved deer

videos.title: In the Family
videos.overview: Drew seeks out a combination of knowledge and experience when he visits four family businesses. He discovers an exciting array of items to sell on

videos.title: Georgian Special
videos.overview: Drew indulges his Georgian obsession in Lincoln, where he falls for a Regency wine cooler. And a bungalow near Stockport hides a vast collection

videos.title: Survivors
videos.overview: Drew finds rare pieces that have stood the test of time. They include an 18th century cabinet in superb original condition and a chest from the Vatican.

videos.title: Ireland Special
videos.overview: Exploring Ireland's thriving antiques world, Drew and new buying partner Alister uncover treasures in private homes and showrooms across the country.

videos.title: Scotland Special
videos.overview: Drew gets an insider's tour of Scotland with local dealer, Viki Knott. He discovers a Mackintosh-influenced chair and some sinister 1960s Americana.

videos.title: Different Is Good
videos.overview: Drew and Alister are on the hunt for exciting stock. They visit a business specializing in the creation of artificial flowers for film and theater.

videos.title: Treading New Ground
videos.overview: Treading new ground across the UK, Drew and Viki explore the factory complex of a historic British cloth producer.

videos.title: Conversation Starters
videos.overview: Drew and Alister's hunt for pieces with an interesting backstory takes them from Sussex to Shropshire with campaign furniture and quirky collectables.

videos.title: Favorite Hunting Grounds
videos.overview: Drew takes fellow dealer Viki to some of the types of hunting ground which have helped to shape his unique take on decorative salvage and antiques.

videos.title: Nature in Design
videos.overview: Drew and Alister hunt for pieces inspired by nature, from a folk-art bird's head walking stick in Brighton to a fireside tiger in Shropshire.

videos.title: Heritage Heroes
videos.overview: Drew and Al buy from heritage sellers snapping up a curved oak settle made in 1810 and century-old steel tables from a Northampton blacksmith.

videos.title: Viki's New Shop
videos.overview: Drew and Viki buy for Viki's new Edinburgh premises and they find deer antlers from a Cumbrian country house and industrial tables from a former tannery.

videos.title: Curated Collections
videos.overview: Drew and Al trawl collections curated by experts unearthing a rare item of motoring history and a 19th-century model ship with a tale to tell.

videos.title: One Stop Shop
videos.overview: Drew and Viki snap up some Ford Maddox Brown chairs and a recliner from a Victorian ocean liner.

videos.title: Fresh Starts
videos.overview: Drew and Viki explore new antiques ventures and they find a Scottish jewelry packing case and a matchstick model made by a prisoner artist.

videos.title: Changing with the Times
videos.overview: Drew and Al find a striking Windsor chair, an anatomical model, and artifacts from a former mill.

videos.title: Talking Shop
videos.overview: With her new shop opening, Viki fills the van while on the road with Drew and they snap up French advertising art and a dolls-house cabinet.

videos.title: Educating AL
videos.overview: Drew teaches Al about buying from sources off limits to the competition and they nab a collection of crucibles and patterns at a Lancashire foundry.

videos.title: Firsts for Viki
videos.overview: Drew takes Viki to three types of hunting grounds that have been staples of his business and they snap up a rare Anglepoise lamp along the way.

videos.title: Forgotten Treasures
videos.overview: Drew snaps up a rare pair of console tables in Sherborne and he visits the UK's last drop hammer tool-making forge before picking in the Cotswolds.

videos.title: Key Hunting Grounds
videos.overview: Drew takes Viki to his favourite treasure hunting grounds and Together they pick through a dusty old shed, a quality auction and a beautiful country house.

videos.title: Long Running Businesses
videos.overview: Drew and Al pick through the collection of a travelling fairground family. Then, they are invited to a traditional wood-turning business.

videos.title: Buying at the Right Price
videos.overview: Drew and Viki deal with a haggling Blacksmith in Yorkshire. Then, they visit a 19th-century country mansion on the south coast of Scotland.

videos.title: Changing Spaces
videos.overview: In Yorkshire, Drew and Al pick through a stash of antiques belonging to a highly regarded dealer.

videos.title: Industrial Heartlands
videos.overview: Drew and Viki tour the Midlands where they visit a shoemaker with a 150-year-old family business and meet a specialist collector of 20th-century lighting.

videos.title: Preserving British Heritage
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Viki Knott search for items that preserve Britain's history. They visit a brass foundry, a stately home, and a salvage yard.

videos.title: Buy What You Like
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Alister Dryburgh uncover hidden gems, including a collection of vintage motorbikes and a new antiques shop in Devon.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Drew and Viki buy from new business ventures. They attend the opening day of an antiques fair and visit a brand-new antiques centre.

videos.title: Country House Antiques
videos.overview: Drew and Al buy from sellers who share their love for country house antiques. They snap up an 18th-century chest of drawers and smokers' bow chairs

videos.title: Lifelong Collectors
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Viki Knott travel across the country, visiting incredible collectors who have collections of unusual, rare and historic treasures.

videos.title: Trusted Hunting Grounds
videos.overview: Drew takes Al on a tour of trusted contacts, finding classic signage in a Kent railway shed, and an African colonial table at a Sussex antiques shop.

videos.title: Eclectic Finds
videos.overview: On the road buying with Viki, Drew finds an extraordinary scratch-built model in Suffolk. In Kent, he snaps up a stunning garden statue of Mr Punch.

videos.title: Trade Tip Offs
videos.overview: Drew Pritchard and Alister Dryburgh visit three promising new antique trade contacts who they've been tipped off about.

videos.title: Surprising Finds
videos.overview: Drew and Viki hunt down surprising and desirable items. They visit a classic car collection in Durham and a favourite dealer in Edinburgh.

videos.title: Trusted Contacts
videos.overview: Drew hits the road with Viki and Alister to visit some of his most trusted contacts, including a favourite dealer in Kent and a new shop in Lancaster.

videos.title: Master Artisans
videos.overview: Alister, Serkan and Jay hunt for items made by highly skilled craftspeople. They visit a traditional boatyard, a signwriter and a master carver.

videos.title: Fresh to Market
videos.overview: At a historic mill, Viki snaps up an untouched weaver's table. Trawling a former RAF airbase, Serkan finds a handbook used in the Battle of Britain.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: At a multi-generational family estate, Al snaps up vintage deed boxes. Plus, Serkan buys hand-painted figures from the old fairground organ.

videos.title: End of an ERA
videos.overview: As a hat factory shuts, Serkan rescues industrial relics. Plus, trawling the wares of a prop supplier, Viki finds paintings by a famous local artist.

videos.title: History Lessons
videos.overview: Serkan buys ancient fire-safety equipment, while Viki wonders if she's lost the plot when she's tempted by a plywood hobbyhorse with a tale to tell.

videos.title: Rare Survivors
videos.overview: Serkan and Jay visit a Victorian steam museum, while Serkan and Alister Dryburgh get to trawl through storage containers at a Kent country house.

videos.title: Provenance Counts
videos.overview: Serkan, Jay and Viki hunt for items with remarkable history. In Somerset they visit a family-run quarry, and a collection of circus artefacts.

videos.title: Lost Relics
videos.overview: The team find lost relics of bygone times, including stools made for child-workers at an old hat dyer's factory and some classic fairground art.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The team hunt for items their clients will love. In Lancashire Viki buys a set of laboratory lamps, in London Serkan nabs a 1930s papier mâché lion.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Hunting for rare treasures, the team visit a colourful collection of Americana, a historic shipping warehouse, and a huge indoor flea market in Wales.
